FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.description: Here are some common questions we receive about our platform. If you have any additional questions, feel free to contact us.
FAQ.faqQuestion1: What features are available in the MVP?
FAQ.faqAnswer1: Our current focus is to offer the essential features to validate the proposal. More advanced features are already being developed and will be released soon.
FAQ.faqQuestion2: How can I sign up and access the platform?
FAQ.faqAnswer2: The registration process is simple and fast. Use the registration form on the homepage to create your account and start using the available resources.
FAQ.faqQuestion3: Is there support for advanced features?
FAQ.faqAnswer3: At the moment, we only offer support for basic features. As the project progresses, advanced features will be implemented and supported.
FAQ.faqQuestion4: When will new features be available?
FAQ.faqAnswer4: We are constantly working to improve the platform. Stay tuned for our updates, as new features will be released as the project evolves.
FAQ.faqQuestion5: How can I send feedback or report issues?
FAQ.faqAnswer5: We value your opinion! Use the contact link or access the Feedback section to send us your suggestions and report any issues.
